title: Pinterest Data Extractor
description: Extract Pinterest pins, boards, profiles, and keyword trends from any URL or search term. Paste URLs and/or keywords — the actor auto-detects each input's type.

startUrls.title: Pinterest URLs
startUrls.description: Use this when you have specific Pinterest URLs to extract — pins, boards, or profiles. The actor auto-detects each URL's type (e.g. 'https://www.pinterest.com/pin/241294492639523463/', 'https://www.pinterest.com/nike/', or a board URL 'https://www.pinterest.com/nike/shoes/'). Leave empty if you only use Search terms. NOT for keyword searches — put keywords in 'searchTerms'.
startUrls.sectionDescription: Provide Pinterest URLs, search terms, or both. At least one is required. You can mix URL types and keywords in a single run.

searchTerms.title: Search terms / keywords
searchTerms.description: Use this when you want to search Pinterest by keyword, topic, or niche (e.g. 'home office decor'). Each term returns matching pins, plus one keyword-discovery record with related queries. Leave empty if you only use Pinterest URLs. NOT a URL — paste links into 'startUrls' instead.

resultsType.title: Results type
resultsType.description: Which record types to return. 'auto' (default) returns the natural type for each input — pins for searches, the pin/board/profile for URLs, plus keyword records for searches. Set to a specific type to force/filter output to only pins, boards, profiles, or keywords. Use 'auto' unless you need exactly one type.

maxItems.title: Max items per input
maxItems.description: Maximum records to return per input (per search term or per URL). For example 50 returns up to 50 pins for each search term. Defaults to 50; valid range 1–10000. Higher values cost more (charged per record) and take longer.

includeRelatedPins.title: Include related pins (pin URLs only)
includeRelatedPins.description: When extracting a single pin URL, also return Pinterest's 'More like this' related pins. Off by default to keep single-pin runs cheap and focused. Only affects pin URLs — ignored for boards, profiles, and searches. Turning this on increases the number of charged pin records.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings. Pinterest blocks datacenter IPs, so residential proxies are strongly recommended and used by default. Leave as-is unless you have a specific proxy requirement. Requires Apify Proxy access on your account.
